citeinfo.title: MRO CTX, DEM InSight
citeinfo.othercit: Golombek, M., Kipp, D., Warner, N. et al. Space Sci Rev (2017) 211: 5.

descript.abstract: This is a Digital Elevation Model mosaic of the InSight Landing Site. It was created by creating individual DEMs from CTX, HiRISE, and HRSC stereo image pairs then merging them together with the Aimes Stereo Pipeline.
descript.purpose: These data were created in support of landing site selection for the InSight landing site.
